event.description: Repair PAD-row table construction for MPS and rerun
event.proposal: family: token representation; implementation repair for attempt-0052: the candidate's train log failed before optimization because MPS does not implement index_copy when materializing the fixed PAD row. Current retained incumbent is 2884 parameters at 99.9900%, a +0.99 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family accepted result: attempt-0002, reversed operand token order at 5056/99.98%; same-family failed result: attempt-0052, the intended PAD-row compression at 2870 parameters with train_exit 1 from the MPS index_copy error; prior attempts in this family: 4. Rebuild the identical 14-trainable-row plus fixed-zero-PAD table using torch.cat, with no architecture or acceptance-rule change. This repair is more informative than switching to fixing an active BOS/EOS row because it resolves a reproducible infrastructure/implementation incompatibility while preserving the exact unused-row hypothesis; the nearest untested alternative remains fixing another active token, which would change the tested representation. Keep d14/h2/L2, MQA, independent head-local maps, ff23, rank8 positions, affine-free block pre-norms, final learned scale without bias, reversed operands, zero weight decay, mixed-digit curriculum, and 30000 steps; retain only official accuracy >=99% and strictly below 2884 parameters.
